dialogues.title: What should we eat for lunch?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {ねえ、}お昼、何食べる？
lines.en: Hey, what do you want for lunch?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {うーん、}ラーメンは？
lines.en: Hmm, how about ramen?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {えー、}ラーメンは昨日食べたよ。
lines.en: Ugh, I had ramen yesterday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、そっか。
lines.en: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {なんか、}駅の前に新しいすし屋が…
lines.en: There's this new sushi place in front of the station...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あー、でも、すしは高いよ。
lines.en: Ah, but sushi's expensive.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {まあ、}そうだね。{じゃあ、}カレーは？
lines.en: Well, true. Then how about curry?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: カレー、{昨日、あ、}おとといの晩ご飯だった。
lines.en: Curry... I had it yesterday, uh, the day before yesterday for dinner.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {もう、}じゃあ、そばは？安いし、近いし。
lines.en: Geez. Then soba? It's cheap, and it's close.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うん、そば、いいね。そうしよう。
lines.en: Yeah, soba sounds good. Let's do that.

questions.question: What do they finally decide to eat?
choices: Ramen
Sushi
Curry
Soba noodles

questions.question: Why does Kenta reject the new sushi place?
choices: He ate sushi two days ago
He thinks it costs too much
It is far from the station
Misaki had sushi yesterday

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あのさ、}テレビの、{あれ、}リモコン、知らない？
lines.en: Hey, do you know where the TV... uh, the remote is?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: リモコン？テーブルの上は？
lines.en: The remote? What about on the table?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: ない。{さっき、}見たけど。
lines.en: It's not there. I looked earlier.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {じゃあ、}ソファーの下…
lines.en: Then under the sofa...

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 下も見た。
lines.en: I looked under it too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {うーん、}あ、昨日の夜、リモコン持って台所に行ったよね？
lines.en: Hmm... oh, last night you went to the kitchen holding the remote, didn't you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: え、そう？{ああ、}アイス…
lines.en: Huh, did I? Oh... the ice cream...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うん。
lines.en: Yeah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あ、}あった！冷蔵庫の中！
lines.en: Oh, found it! Inside the fridge!

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {もう、}なんで冷蔵庫なの…
lines.en: Honestly, why the fridge...

questions.question: Where was the remote in the end?
choices: On the table
Under the sofa
In the refrigerator
Next to the TV

questions.question: What most likely happened last night?
choices: Shou carried the remote along when he went for ice cream
Yumi hid the remote under the sofa
Shou watched TV in the kitchen
Yumi left the remote on the table

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {ねえ、}日曜日、公園でピクニックしない？
lines.en: Hey, want to have a picnic in the park on Sunday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あ、}いいね。どこの公園？
lines.en: Oh, nice. Which park?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {えっと、}川の近くの、大きい公園。
lines.en: Um, the big park near the river.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あー、はいはい。
lines.en: Ah, yeah, yeah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: お弁当、わたしが作るね。{それで、}大輔は…
lines.en: I'll make the lunch boxes. And you, Daisuke...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 飲み物？
lines.en: Drinks?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん、飲み物と、{あと、}果物。
lines.en: Yeah, drinks and, um, fruit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: オッケー。{えっと、}朝は何時に行く？
lines.en: OK. Um, what time do we go in the morning?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {うーん、}十時は？
lines.en: Hmm, how about ten?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 十時、ちょっと早いなあ。十一時にしない？
lines.en: Ten's a little early. Can we make it eleven?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {まあ、}いいよ。じゃあ、十一時ね。
lines.en: Well, OK. Eleven, then.

questions.question: What will Daisuke bring?
choices: The lunch boxes
Drinks and fruit
Only drinks
Nothing; Yoko brings everything

questions.question: What time do they finally agree on, and whose idea was it?
choices: Ten, Yoko's idea
Ten, Daisuke's idea
Eleven, Yoko's idea
Eleven, Daisuke's idea

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: おかえり。{えっと、}今日、学校どうだった？
lines.en: Welcome home. So, how was school today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あのね、あのね、}今日、体育でサッカーしたの！
lines.en: Guess what, guess what, we played soccer in P.E. today!

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: へえ。
lines.en: Oh, wow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {それで、}ぼく、{一回、あ、}二回、ゴールした！
lines.en: And I scored one... no, two goals!

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: すごいね！
lines.en: That's great!

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: でも、{その、}お弁当、ちょっと残しちゃった。
lines.en: But, um, I left some of my lunch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: え、どうして？
lines.en: Huh, why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {なんか、}おなかが痛くて…
lines.en: My tummy kind of hurt...

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: え、大丈夫？
lines.en: Oh no, are you OK?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うん、もう大丈夫。{あ、}おやつある？
lines.en: Yeah, I'm fine now. Oh, is there a snack?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {もう、}元気だね。
lines.en: Well, you're clearly feeling fine.

questions.question: Why didn't Hikaru finish his lunch?
choices: He was busy playing soccer
His stomach was hurting
He wanted to save room for a snack
He was too excited about his goals

questions.question: How is Hikaru at the end of the conversation?
choices: Still sick and wants to lie down
Upset about the soccer game
Worried about his leftover lunch
Feeling better and hungry for a snack

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あ、}田中くん、{ちょっと、}宿題のことなんだけど…
lines.en: Oh, Tanaka, um, about the homework...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うん。
lines.en: Yeah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 数学の宿題、{何ページ、えっと、}何ページまで？
lines.en: The math homework, up to... um, up to which page?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {えっと、}三十ページまで。
lines.en: Um, up to page thirty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: え、三十？二十五じゃない？
lines.en: What, thirty? Wasn't it twenty-five?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: ううん、先生、三十って言ったよ。
lines.en: Nope, the teacher said thirty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {うわ、}多い…
lines.en: Ugh, that's a lot...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {でも、}問題は簡単だよ。
lines.en: But the problems are easy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 本当？{じゃあ、}今日、図書館で一緒に…
lines.en: Really? Then today, at the library, together...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、ごめん、今日はバイト。明日は？
lines.en: Oh, sorry, I have my part-time job today. How about tomorrow?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん、明日の放課後ね。
lines.en: OK, tomorrow after school.

questions.question: Why is Ai surprised?
choices: The homework goes further than she thought
The problems look very hard
Tanaka can't study with her today
The teacher changed the homework

questions.question: When will they study together?
choices: Today at the library
Tonight after his job
Tomorrow after school
They won't study together

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {ねえ、}お兄ちゃん、自転車貸して。
lines.en: Hey, big brother, lend me your bike.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {えー、}なんで？
lines.en: Ugh, why?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あの、}友達の家に行くの。
lines.en: Um, I'm going to my friend's house.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {自分の、}お前の自転車は？
lines.en: What about your own... your bike?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: タイヤが…
lines.en: The tire...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あー、パンクか。
lines.en: Ah, a flat, huh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん。{だから、}お願い！五時に返すから。
lines.en: Yeah. So please! I'll bring it back at five.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {うーん、}いいけど、六時に塾があるから、それまでに返してね。
lines.en: Hmm, fine, but I have cram school at six, so bring it back before then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん、大丈夫！ありがとう！
lines.en: Sure, no problem! Thanks!

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あ、}あと、鍵、玄関にあるから。
lines.en: Oh, and the key's by the front door.

questions.question: Why does the sister want her brother's bike?
choices: Her own bike has a flat tire
She lost her bike key
His bike is faster
She has cram school at six

questions.question: What condition does the brother give?
choices: She must fix her own tire first
She must take him to cram school
She must have it back before six
She must leave the key at her friend's house

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あのね、}先週、猫を飼い始めたの。
lines.en: Guess what, I got a cat last week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: え、ほんと？
lines.en: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん。{その、}まだ小さい白い猫。
lines.en: Yeah. Um, a little white one, still small.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: へえ、かわいい。名前は？
lines.en: Aw, cute. What's its name?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {えっと、}「ゆき」。
lines.en: Um, Yuki. ("Snow")

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、白いから？
lines.en: Oh, because it's white?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうそう。{でも、}夜、ぜんぜん寝ないの。
lines.en: Exactly. But it doesn't sleep at all at night.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あー、}子猫はそうだよね。
lines.en: Ah, kittens are like that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {それで、}朝、わたしの顔の上に…
lines.en: And in the morning, right on my face...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 乗るの？
lines.en: It climbs on you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん、毎朝。{もう、}眠くて。
lines.en: Yep, every morning. I'm so sleepy.

questions.question: Why is the cat called Yuki?
choices: Because of its color
Because it is so small
Because it sleeps so much
Because it came last week

questions.question: What problem does Yamada have with the cat?
choices: She can't decide on a name
It wakes her up every morning
It sleeps all day long
It is too small to play

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あ、}昨日、映画見たよ。
lines.en: Oh, I saw a movie yesterday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: へえ、何の映画？
lines.en: Oh? What movie?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {えっと、}犬の映画。{なんか、}犬が、{その、}家に帰る話。
lines.en: Um, a dog movie. It's, like, a story about a dog going back home.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あー、あれ？おもしろかった？
lines.en: Ah, that one? Was it good?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん、すごく。{でも、}ちょっと長かった。三時間。
lines.en: Yeah, really. But it was a bit long. Three hours.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 三時間？{うわ、}長い。
lines.en: Three hours? Wow, that's long.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {それで、}最後に、{ぼく、}泣いちゃった。
lines.en: And at the end, I, uh, cried.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: えー、翼くんが？
lines.en: What, you, Tsubasa?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん。{あの、}花ちゃんも見る？今度の土曜日、一緒に…
lines.en: Yeah. Um, do you want to see it too, Hana? This Saturday, together...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {うーん、}長い映画はちょっと…{でも、}いいよ。
lines.en: Hmm, long movies aren't really my thing... but sure.

questions.question: What is the movie about?
choices: A dog that finds its way home
A family who buys a dog
A boy who cries a lot
A long trip on a Saturday

questions.question: How does Hana respond to the invitation?
choices: She refuses because it is too long
She says she has already seen it
She suggests a shorter movie
She agrees, though she isn't keen on long movies

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あの、}すみません、この席、空いてますか。
lines.en: Um, excuse me, is this seat free?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あ、}はい、どうぞ。
lines.en: Oh, yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: ありがとうございます。{えっと、}林です。今日から、このクラスです。
lines.en: Thank you. Um, I'm Hayashi. I'm in this class from today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、石川です。よろしく。{えっと、}林さんは、どこから…
lines.en: Oh, I'm Ishikawa. Nice to meet you. So, where are you from...

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 大阪から来ました。
lines.en: I came from Osaka.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: へえ、大阪！{僕、あ、}私も、去年まで大阪に住んでいました。
lines.en: Oh, Osaka! I, uh, I also lived in Osaka until last year.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: え、本当ですか。
lines.en: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: はい。{あの、}大阪のどこですか。
lines.en: Yes. Um, where in Osaka?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {えっと、}駅の近くです。{でも、}東京は初めてで…
lines.en: Um, near the station. But this is my first time in Tokyo, so...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あ、}じゃあ、今度、学校の近くの店、案内しますよ。
lines.en: Oh, then next time I'll show you the shops near school.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うれしいです。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: I'd love that. Thank you.

questions.question: What do Hayashi and Ishikawa have in common?
choices: Both are new to the class
Both live near the station
Both have lived in Osaka
Both grew up in Tokyo

questions.question: What does Ishikawa offer to do?
choices: Show her around the shops near school
Take her to the station in Osaka
Introduce her to the class
Find her a different seat

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {よし、}カレー作ろう。{えっと、}肉、ある？
lines.en: Right, let's make curry. Um, do we have meat?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うん、肉はある。じゃがいもと、にんじんも。
lines.en: Yeah, there's meat. Potatoes and carrots too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 玉ねぎは？
lines.en: Onions?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {えっと、}玉ねぎ…{あれ、}ない。
lines.en: Um, onions... huh, there aren't any.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: え、ない？
lines.en: What, none?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うん、昨日、お母さんが…
lines.en: Yeah, yesterday Mom...

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あ、}スープに使ったんだ。
lines.en: Oh, she used them in soup.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {じゃあ、}わたし、スーパーに買いに行こうか。
lines.en: Then should I go buy some at the supermarket?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {うーん、}いいよ、いいよ。今日は玉ねぎなしで作ろう。
lines.en: Hmm, nah, it's fine. Let's make it without onions today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: えー、玉ねぎがないカレー？{まあ、}いっか。
lines.en: What, curry with no onions? Well, whatever.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うん、{その、}次はちゃんと買っておくから。
lines.en: Yeah, um, I'll make sure to buy some next time.

questions.question: Why are there no onions?
choices: The daughter forgot to buy them
Dad already put them in the curry
They were left at the supermarket
Mom used them up making soup

questions.question: What do they decide to do?
choices: Go to the supermarket for onions
Make the curry without onions
Make soup instead of curry
Wait for Mom to come home

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あ、}中村さん、おはようございます。{なんか、}眠そうですね。
lines.en: Oh, morning, Nakamura. You look kind of sleepy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {ああ、}おはようございます。昨日、遅くまで会議の資料を…
lines.en: Ah, morning. Last night I was up late on the materials for the meeting...

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: あー、明日の会議の？
lines.en: Ah, for tomorrow's meeting?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうなんです。{えっと、}まだ終わってなくて。
lines.en: That's right. Um, and it's still not done.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 大変ですね。{あ、}このコーヒー、ボタンを押しても…{あれ？}出ない。
lines.en: That's rough. Oh, this coffee, even when I press the button... huh? Nothing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あ、}それ、壊れてるんですよ。先週から。
lines.en: Oh, that one's broken. Since last week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: え、そうなんですか。
lines.en: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {はい、}二階の機械は使えますよ。
lines.en: Yeah, the machine on the second floor works.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {じゃあ、}中村さんの分も、買ってきましょうか。
lines.en: Then shall I get one for you too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {え、}いいんですか。{じゃあ、あ、}砂糖なしでお願いします。
lines.en: Oh, are you sure? Then, uh, no sugar, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。資料も、手伝いましょうか？午後、時間ありますから。
lines.en: Sure. Shall I help with the materials too? I have time this afternoon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 本当ですか。助かります。
lines.en: Really? That'd be a huge help.

questions.question: Why is Nakamura so tired?
choices: The meeting yesterday ran very late
He climbed the stairs from the second floor
He stayed up working on documents for a meeting
He hasn't had any coffee since last week

questions.question: What is Sato going to do right after this?
choices: Try to fix the broken machine
Get coffee for both of them from another floor
Buy some sugar for Nakamura
Go to the meeting in his place

questions.question: What else does Sato offer?
choices: To attend tomorrow's meeting for him
To call someone about the machine
To buy him lunch
To help him finish the documents

dialogues.title: Buying a ticket at the station

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あの、}すみません、桜台までの切符は、どこで買えますか。
lines.en: Um, excuse me, where can I buy a ticket to Sakuradai?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {はい、}桜台ですね。こちらの機械でも買えますよ。
lines.en: Yes, Sakuradai. You can buy one at this machine as well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {ええと、}機械はちょっと、よくわからなくて…
lines.en: Well, machines are a bit... I don't really understand them...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {あ、}では、ここでどうぞ。
lines.en: Ah, then please buy it here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: お願いします。{あの、}急行は止まりますか。
lines.en: Thank you. Um, does the express stop there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {えー、}急行は止まりません。普通電車で、四十分ぐらいです。
lines.en: Er, the express doesn't stop there. It's about forty minutes on a local train.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 四十分…{じゃあ、}次の電車は何時ですか。
lines.en: Forty minutes... Then what time is the next train?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 十時十五分です。三番線から出ます。
lines.en: Ten fifteen. It leaves from platform three.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 三番線…{あ、}階段は…
lines.en: Platform three... oh, the stairs...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: エレベーターもありますよ。あちらです。
lines.en: There's an elevator too. It's over there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {まあ、}助かります。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Oh, that helps a lot. Thank you very much.

questions.question: Why does the woman buy her ticket from the staff member?
choices: The ticket machine is out of order
She finds the ticket machine confusing
She needs a special express ticket
The staff member told her to

questions.question: How will she get to Sakuradai?
choices: Express train, about 40 minutes
Express train, about 15 minutes
Local train, about 15 minutes
Local train, about 40 minutes

questions.question: Why is she relieved at the end?
choices: She doesn't have to use the stairs
The next train leaves right away
The express stops at her station
The ticket was cheaper than expected

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {もしもし、あ、}真理？ごめん、{今、}今、駅に着いた。
lines.en: Hello, uh, Mari? Sorry, I just got to the station now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: え、今？約束、十時だったよね。
lines.en: What, just now? We said ten, didn't we?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {うん、}ごめん、{その、}目覚まし時計が…
lines.en: Yeah, sorry, my, um, alarm clock...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 鳴らなかったの？
lines.en: It didn't go off?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {いや、}鳴ったんだけど、止めて、また寝ちゃって。
lines.en: No, it did, but I turned it off and fell back asleep.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {もう、}映画、十時半からだよ。
lines.en: Seriously. The movie starts at ten thirty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {あと、}あと二十分ぐらいで…
lines.en: I'll be there in about twenty more...

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 間に合わないじゃん。
lines.en: You won't make it, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: {だから、}先に入ってて。チケット、送るから。
lines.en: So go in ahead of me. I'll send you the ticket.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: {うーん、}わかった。じゃあ、ポップコーンは拓也のおごりね。
lines.en: Hmm, fine. But then the popcorn's on you, Takuya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい、もちろんです…
lines.en: Yes, of course...

questions.question: Why is Takuya late?
choices: His alarm clock didn't ring
He switched off his alarm and slept again
He got on the wrong train
He thought they were meeting at ten thirty
